_doc: The Sovereign: GDD 7.4. Acts advance on clues; agendas advance on entropy. Effects are story ops (mech/story.py).
name: The Sovereign
subtitle: Scenario I
intro: LANTERN: Pod's through. You're inside the Sovereign. Rook, the walls are breathing on my feed.
LANTERN: The Queen is dormant, somewhere deep. Every minute she sleeps less. Find the way in. Kill her.

BROOD.text: -1, or -2 if an enemy is here.

acts.name: Breach
acts.front: Find a way through the outer hive. Lantern needs readings to map the inner corridors.
acts.back: The walls remember the shape of a corridor. Lantern finds it in the noise. A path opens toward the Throne Approach.

acts.name: The Path Inward
acts.front: The Approach is guarded and thick with song. Gather enough to read the Queen's chamber.
acts.back: The Approach opens like a throat. Something enormous breathes beyond it.

acts.name: Regicide
acts.front: Enter the Queen's Chamber and kill her.

agendas.name: She Dreams
agendas.front: The hive is quiet. Too quiet. Somewhere deep, a heart beats once a minute.
agendas.back: A pulse runs through the hull. Every egg in the Nursery turns toward you.

agendas.name: The Choir Wakes
agendas.front: Lantern's voice keeps breaking up. The singing is getting louder.
agendas.back: Lantern's voice breaks into static. The singing is inside the comms now.

agendas.name: Coronation
agendas.front: The heartbeat is constant now. She is almost here.

R1.name: Regicide
R1.text: The hive screams with one voice, then none. The Sovereign drifts, dead, toward a slow and silent orbit.

R2.name: A Waking Death
R2.text: She dies awake. Through the hull you hear the brood scatter, falling toward the cities without a mind.

R3.name: Coronation
R3.text: The Sovereign turns toward the planet. You reach the pod with her voice in your teeth.

DEFEAT.name: Lost in the Hive
DEFEAT.text: Lantern keeps calling your name, long after the signal stops answering.
